description: Search or list the latest articles from Barrio Energy's newsletter The Grid Report: weekly reporting on the Texas grid, ERCOT, Batch Zero and the large load interconnection process, PUCT dockets, data center and battery development, transmission build-out (765 kV, STEP), powered land and county politics. Returns title, date, link and a summary; ask for full text of one article by id. Use when someone asks what is new on the Texas grid, about Batch Zero or ERCOT large loads, or wants context and sources on a Texas power topic. Free and unmetered.

article_id.description: Return the full text of one article, e.g. 'article-51'.

query.description: Keywords to search titles and text, e.g. 'Batch Zero', '765 kV', 'Nueces', 'battery'. Omit for the latest articles.

since_days.description: Only articles published in the last N days.

name: grid_news
title: Latest Texas grid news from The Grid Report
